source_caption:
🎬 Unpregnant (2020)

Unpregnant follows Veronica Clarke, a smart and ambitious 17-year-old high school student whose carefully planned future takes an unexpected turn when she discovers she is pregnant. Determined to pursue her dreams of attending college and building the life she wants, Veronica decides to seek an abortion. However, restrictive laws in her home state of Missouri make accessing the procedure without parental involvement extremely difficult. With limited options and little time, she reluctantly turns to Bailey Butler, her former best friend, whose rebellious personality and unpredictable behavior are completely different from her own. Together, the two teenagers embark on an extraordinary road trip across several states to reach a clinic in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Along the way, they encounter unusual strangers, hilarious misunderstandings, dangerous situations, and unexpected adventures that test their patience and determination. As the journey continues, Veronica and Bailey begin confronting the misunderstandings and painful experiences that caused their friendship to fall apart. Through moments of humor, vulnerability, and emotional honesty, they rediscover the importance of supporting each other during life’s most difficult decisions. Combining road-trip comedy, heartfelt drama, and meaningful social commentary, Unpregnant explores friendship, reproductive choice, independence, growing up, personal responsibility, and the importance of having control over one’s future.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Adventure

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 43m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Rachel Lee Goldenberg

✍️ Based on the Novel By: Jenni Hendriks & Ted Caplan

source_details.synopsis: Unpregnant is a 2020 American female buddy road comedy-drama film co-written and directed by Rachel Lee Goldenberg, based on the novel of the same name by Ted Caplan and Jenni Hendriks. It stars Haley Lu Richardson and Barbie Ferreira, with Alex MacNicoll, Breckin Meyer, Giancarlo Esposito, Sugar Lyn Beard, and Betty Who. The film follows a pregnant teenager, Veronica (Richardson), who discovers that she cannot get an abortion in her home state of Missouri without her parents' permission and subsequently convinces her former friend Bailey (Ferreira) to take a road trip with her to Albuquerque so she can get one there. It was released on September 10, 2020, by HBO Max.
